svg.aria-label: UML class diagram of the BazarGhat Laravel application: 26 Eloquent model classes with their mass-assignable attributes and domain operations, joined by 44 associations. User and Order are the hubs; the clusters cover delivery, products and flash sales, returns and refunds, complaints, and coupons.
svg.title: BazarGhat — UML Class Diagram (Eloquent models)

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: UML class diagram of the Laravel domain model · 26 Eloquent classes, 44 associations

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attributes are the model's mass-assignable columns; operations exclude relationship accessors, which are drawn as associations.

svg.text: association, with multiplicity and role names at its ends (1 — * or 1 — 0..1)

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every association is an Eloquent relationship declared on the models: hasMany / hasOne give 1 — * and 1 — 0..1, belongsTo supplies the inverse role shown at the other end.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: User and Order each carry several associations to the same class (Refund by customer and by approver, CustomerCoupon by customer and by assigned_by, Order to itself through replacement_for_order_id).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FlashSale also declares products() as a many-to-many through the flash_sale_products pivot, drawn here as the two owning associations. ReturnRequest maps to the returns table; Product maps to products.
